device: CPU only (same limits as the main order)
note_order: the main order's bundle 가 and 나 were both delivered before this addendum arrived; the addendum runs after them
gt_use: checks 1-8: no GT; the population is in-limit patches (JC base geometry code 0, base judgment 일치) and photo points whose member patches are all inside L (JC all_within). check 9: GT only for scoring (main order 1.7)
weights: area-weighted 10/25/50/75/90 % (JC quantile rule); per prior unit (LoD2 roof, LoD2 wall, ALS roof) and search region plus pooled

inputs.patch: JP patch_<prior>.npz (JC values in JC gid order): centre, normal, kind, area, region, building, face (JC place), place, d_for_check, r_m, u_M, sigma_P, n, geometry, texture_P
inputs.ring_counts: WIDEN0 patch_values (+ holdout/patch_values) <tile>__<prior>__R1.5.npz joined by patch_id, only for patches with geometry_raw widen0_same_centre (JC base u_M = WIDEN0 u for those): mvs_a_n_ring (points used, capped 8000), mvs_a_ring_found (found), mvs_a_n_inner_all, mvs_a_s0 (LMedS ring-plane scale = ring scatter s); ALS prior also als_* for sigma_P
inputs.photo: JP photo_<prior>.npz (all_within, kind, region, area, s_P, s_M, texture)
inputs.t: JC/JP t per search region x prior x kind

check1.variogram: in-limit patches, value e = d - r; pairs within the same building and the same JC face (place face); 3-D centre distance bins 0.25 m over 0-6 m; per prior unit x search region at most 2,000,000 random pairs (anchors drawn with seed 20261117, all neighbours within 6 m of each anchor, then a random subset); semivariance per bin = NMAD(e_i - e_j)^2 / 2; plateau = mean of the bins in 4-6 m; correlation distance = first bin centre where the semivariance >= 95 % (and 50 %) of the plateau; 'not reached' if none; also first bin / plateau
check1.condition_a: (0.5 + R) / 2 >= the 95 % correlation distance of the ALS roof unit (image-depth error) of the same search region; LoD2 units reported on their own variogram too
check1.condition_b: sigma_face = s / sqrt(N) * sqrt(1 + 4 * 0.5^2 / (R^2 + 0.5^2)); s = mvs_a_s0, N = mvs_a_n_ring at R = 1.5; for R = 1.0 and 3.0 N = min(8000, ring_found * (R^2 - 0.25) / (1.5^2 - 0.25)) and s unchanged (approximation, stated); N_eff = min(N, pi (R^2 - 0.25) / L50^2) with L50 = 50 % correlation distance of the unit and region; condition sigma_face <= u_M / 3 (u_M of that radius: JC base for 1.5, JC ring_1.0 / ring_3.0); reference rows 20 s and 25 s, share 25 s <= 1.5 m
check1.condition_c: distance from the patch centre to the nearest boundary patch of the same building and face (a patch of the face with fewer than 8 same-face patches within 0.36 m); condition distance >= R; compare share >= 1.5 m with JC place '면 안쪽'
check1.stability: u_M(1.0)/u_M(1.5), u_M(3.0)/u_M(1.5), u_M(same face)/u_M(1.5) by place

check2.density: n / (pi r^2), r = 0.075 m roof, 0.125 m wall; with and without n < 4
check2.rule: smallest r with P(Poisson(rho pi r^2) >= 4) = 0.95 (lambda = 7.754) at the 10 % and 50 % density

check3.d: |d| of n >= 4 patches (all geometry codes); 90, 99, 99.9 % and max; share within 1 m of the length end (roof 9-10 m, wall 4-5 m); the 10 m wall cylinder = not stored for the campus patches -> 확인 불가 unless found

check4.building: agreement_for_calibration patches per building (JC geometry/base) n_b, NMAD of d - r; SE = 1.2533 NMAD / sqrt(n_b); n_eff = min(n_b, building agreement area / L50^2); n_needed = (1.2533 NMAD / (sigma_W / 3))^2

check5.rule1: smallest texture bin (lower edge) from which the share of s_P < t is below 10 % in every higher bin
check5.rule2: sample photo points: noise per image pair = SD of the residual after a linear gain/offset fit of one view's patch intensities to the other's / sqrt(2); sigma_n = median over pairs; texture threshold = sigma_n sqrt(t / (1 - t)) per region (t <= 0 -> 구할 수 없음)

sample.allocation: proportional to the area of all_within photo points per search region
sample.code: JC photo_cameras.Cameras projection and the photo_score.py patch grid (25 x 25, 2 cm, pyramid level by ground sample distance) re-implemented on CPU for the sample only

variants.고정 1 기준 1 %: t = area-weighted 1 % of s_P over the same all_within sample as JC t (per region x prior x kind)
variants.고정 3 무늬 3: photo code 6 when both texture < 3 (instead of 5)

check9.texture_3_missing_scores: photo points that leave code 6 but have no stored s_P or s_M keep the base code (area recorded)
check9.rest: photo code order, decision table, default, targets, all other values = JC base; then the main order's scoring
check9.jc_sensitivity: JC judge/<ring_1.0|ring_3.0|z_1.645|z_2.576|centre_shift|building_r|same_face_ring> method region and target_h read and scored the same way (names 고정 5..11)
check9.qualitative: 기준 10 % and 무늬 8 vs base: GT points whose target-ok changed, 0.25 m cells joined within 0.6 m per building, two largest became-right and two largest became-wrong (one per building), layout of main figure 4
